title_zh: 约定核实花园展板的植物与传统信息

scenario.label_zh: 约定核实花园展板的植物与传统信息
scenario.goal_zh: 区分原生植物与后引入植物，并约定请相关社群核对传统知识的介绍

context_zh: 花园工作人员依据地方植物目录审阅展板，拟在公开前向当地原住民文化中心核实传统知识说明。
author: author-phase11-a

sentences.speaker: Ari
sentences.text: This panel says all the plants here are indigenous to the valley. Is that right?

sentences.speaker: Helen
sentences.text: No. The local plant catalogue lists these three as native, but the roses were introduced later.

sentences.speaker: Ari
sentences.text: The roses certainly flourish here. I suppose that does not prove they came from here.

sentences.speaker: Helen
sentences.text: Exactly. And the paragraph about cultural heritage needs another check; we wrote it without input from the local Indigenous cultural centre.

sentences.speaker: Ari
sentences.text: I'll separate the plant origins, then ask the centre whether and how the traditional uses should be described.

sentences.speaker: Helen
sentences.text: Good. Keep that paragraph off the display until we have their response.
